N.required_unit: Must match training dataset's original unit and sampling method.

P.required_unit: Must match training dataset's original unit and sampling method.

K.required_unit: Must match training dataset's original unit and sampling method.

temperature.required_unit: degree Celsius; averaging window must match training data.

humidity.required_unit: percent; aggregation window must match training data.

ph.required_unit: dimensionless; method and sampling depth should be documented.

rainfall.required_unit: mm, with period (monthly vs growing-season total) explicitly confirmed.

known_app_behavior.temperature: Mean of daily mean temperature over a recent 90-day window.
known_app_behavior.humidity: Mean of daily mean relative humidity over a recent 90-day window.
known_app_behavior.rainfall: Sum of daily precipitation over that 90-day window divided by 3 (approximate mm/month).
known_app_behavior.soil_card: N/P/K ratings are mapped to dataset quartiles for low/medium/high; this is a proxy mapping, not a verified unit conversion.
known_app_behavior.warning: Do not treat live app inputs as equivalent to training features until original feature definitions, units, and aggregation windows are documented and aligned.
